## About

Aafaque Nazir is a freelance full-stack web developer specializing in building modern, high-performance web applications, custom e-commerce stores, and responsive websites. He works primarily with React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, and Supabase to deliver production-ready digital products with clean code, fast load times, and intuitive UI/UX.

## Services Offered

- **Websites & Landing Pages** — Conversion-focused, responsive websites built with clean code, modern animations (Framer Motion), and SEO best practices.
- **Custom Online Stores (E-Commerce)** — Fast, bespoke e-commerce storefronts with product catalogs, shopping carts, WhatsApp ordering, and payment integrations.
- **Custom Web Applications (SaaS & Dashboards)** — Scalable full-stack web applications, business dashboards, real-time tracking systems, and secure authentication backends with PostgreSQL and Supabase.
